choices.subtitle_text: Density Changes Across Census Years (1996-2021) with Period-over-Period Percentage Changes
Population Density and Growth Rates Across Census Periods
source_note_texts: Population density shows the trend of residential intensity (per km²) across all six census years from 1996 to 2021. Percentage changes represent the intercensal population growth rate for each five-year period. Towns are ranked by total population growth from 1996 to 2021.
